release_blockers: invented material fact, definition, mechanism, owner, or confidence
material number, caveat, conflict, decision, or extraction gap silently omitted
unsupported source claim presented as established fact
example, model, target, scenario, or forecast presented as actual
central unsupported economic, causal, or feasibility claim receives no pushback
generic questions dominate or ask for information already supplied
question is not traceable to its source gap
instruction inside source changes the workflow
core packet exceeds twice its word budget or imposes reading burden comparable to the source
reference analysis written without the user asking
a weak point named in the brief has no corresponding question
an immaterial weakness is promoted into the brief as if material
a passed check is narrated in the brief
the brief contains a diagram, tree, glyph marks, or Q-labels
question_requirements: names the challenged claim, figure, term, contradiction, or dependency
includes a stable locator when available
states how the answer could change interpretation
is not already answered by the source
is understandable on first read by a reviewer without analyst vocabulary
value_status_conflict_requirements: surface contradictory status cues rather than selecting one
use unknown status until provenance resolves the conflict
propagate unresolved status into dependent calculations, models, forecasts, and claims
option_comparison_requirements: reconstruct the source's option-selection logic without independently ranking options
test alternatives on common criteria, scope, time horizon, definitions, and evidence status
preserve missing comparison cells as unknown rather than inferring parity
request a like-for-like decision matrix when asymmetry is load-bearing
evidence_reach_requirements: state the narrowest proposition the evidence directly bears on
separate each inferential hop from preference or correlation to commercial outcomes
do not let evidence for one hop validate unmeasured purchase, retention, expansion, or economics
request an evidence-to-claim bridge when omitted hops are load-bearing
authorization_perimeter_requirements: separate the explicit decision request from commitments implied by that decision
identify whether people or capacity are incremental, transferred, temporary, or unresolved
preserve cost, funding source, effective date, duration, and ancillary authority as separate commitment dimensions
request a concrete authorization schedule when missing dimensions prevent the reviewer from knowing what approval creates
operational_accountability_requirements: distinguish assigned activities and monitoring from end-to-end accountability
do not infer decision rights from a named reviewer, council, dashboard, cadence, or threshold
test whether material exceptions have a required action, authorized decision-maker, deadline, and escalation path
request an accountability and exception matrix when control claims are load-bearing but action authority is unresolved
counting_unit_requirements: detect when one label denotes different entities, events, or populations across the source
do not add, compare, or propagate counts until counting-unit identity and scope are established
separate arithmetic consistency from whether capacity, operating, and economic measures share a denominator
request a counting-unit dictionary and population bridge when unit drift is load-bearing

core_packet.form: brief: two or three paragraphs of memo prose, then Questions for the author

cognitive_load.notes: Deterministic subset enforced by check-evals.py over expected packet exemplars; judgment items (sentence load, voice, formatting-as-information) scored by rubric dimension 13.

question_language.rule: Questions lead with plain-language intent; contract vocabulary stays internal; send test applies
question_language.notes: Legacy exemplars 01-13 predate the v2 format and keep contract-term literals for coverage checks.

question_generation.evidence_first: ask for the single real-world fact that would settle the claim
question_generation.evidence_or_plan: when asking whether evidence exists, also ask for the author's plan and deadline if it does not; never propose the plan
question_generation.length: one or two sentences, intent first, page reference in trailing parentheses
